name: Rating
description:
The Rating component provides a way to select a value from a range of values, typically used for feedback on a scale.

Use the default `<Rating>` for a labeled rating that renders one item per `count` (5 by default), with a render function child that returns each item's icon from its state (`highlighted`, `half`, `checked`), or compose the primitives for full structural control. It supports `readOnly`, half values, two sizes, two palettes and a horizontal or vertical orientation.

parts.name: El
parts.description: An abstraction that renders an optional label and one item per `count`, each showing the icon returned by its render function child (Cerberus stars by default)

props.name: label
props.description: The label of the rating, rendered in `Rating.Label`. A `Rating.Label` child with children replaces it.

props.name: children
props.description: A render function that returns each item's content from its state (`highlighted`, `half`, `checked`), or direct `Rating.Label`, `Rating.Control`, `Rating.Item`, `Rating.ItemContext` and `Rating.HiddenInput` children that override those parts. Without a render function, each item shows a Cerberus star (a half star when `half`).

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value of the rating when rendered. Use when you don't need to control the value of the rating.

props.name: autoFocus

props.description: Function to be called when the rating value changes.

props.name: onHoverChange
props.description: Function to be called when the rating value is hovered.
